851-1283-1651-4772-8276.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Hive by paying {5} and tapping it, creating four 1/1 Wasp artifact creature tokens due to Doubling Season and Adrix and Nev.
Activate Clock of Omens twice by tapping the Wasps, untapping Chromatic Orrery and The Hive.
Repeat.
851-1283-1651-4772-8276.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.

728-3602--5.notablePrerequisites: At least one of the two persist creatures does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
728-3602--5.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a persist creature that does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Bhaal trigger.
Resolve the Bhaal trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the remaining persist creature.
Resolve the sacrificed creature's persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2590-5776-6495.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2590-5776-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as a Food due to Ygra, Experimental Confectioner's second ability and Ygra trigger.
Resolve the Experimental Confectioner trigger, causing you to create a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
2590-5776-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

856-5776-7422-8095.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Garrison Excavator trigger.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

3532-3581-5078-7864.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Ravenhill Flock triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat.

348-1152-3191-5687-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-1152-3191-5687-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Kairi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Kairi and any creature not part of the combo.
When Kairi dies, it and Skittering Precursor triggers.
Resolve the Kairi trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

4369-4875-7855.notablePrerequisites: You are able to put a counter on The Red Terror.
4369-4875-7855.description:
Put a counter on The Red Terror.
The Great Goblin's first ability triggers, as The Red Terror is a Goblin, Orc or Army due to Conspiracy, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

4399-4518-5070-6626.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Angelic Chorus trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Angelic Chorus trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4518-5070-6626.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

3457-5840-7791.description:
Activate Nantuko Elder by tapping it, adding {C}{G}.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Nantuko Elder.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Nantuko Elder.
Repeat.

918-1203.easyPrerequisites: You have more life than an opponent.
918-1203.description:
Cast Fire Covenant by {1}{B}{R} and paying an amount of life equal to an opponent's life total, dealing that much damage to Donna Noble.
Donna Noble triggers, dealing that much damage to the opponent.

2034-3240-5631-6462.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a Treasure token and creature token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

907-1558-2557-3875-4231.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
907-1558-2557-3875-4231.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Parallel Lives.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1874-2308-4050-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
1874-2308-4050-4871.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters, Ajani's Welcome triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {1}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Ajani's Welcome trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

5223-6738-7011-7082.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more Allies.
5223-6738-7011-7082.description:
Cast Razor Boomerang by paying {0} due to Sokka, Swordmaster.
When Razor Boomerang enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sokka and Suki's first ability triggers, attaching Razor Boomerang to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally token by tapping it and unattaching Razor Boomerang, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning Razor Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

296-3532-5078-5705.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
296-3532-5078-5705.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
The Thirteenth Doctor and Glaring Fleshraker's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Thirteenth Doctor trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

997-5702-7084.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

647-4871-7072.description:
Activate Joo Dee by paying {B} and tapping it, causing you to surveil 1 and then create a token copy of Joo Dee and sacrifice the tapped Joo Dee.
When the tapped Joo Dee dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat using the Joo Dee token.

874-955-1170-1329.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-955-1170-1329.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Delif's Cone from your graveyard.
Cast Delif's Cone by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2510-3532-5078-6608.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2510-3532-5078-6608.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Jace's Projection triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

without summoning sickness and with power X or greater

81-725-5256-6730.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X counters on artifacts, creatures and/or enchantments you control, where X is 4 plus the number of times you've cast Sin from the command zone this game.
81-725-5256-6730.description:
Cast Sin either from your hand or command zone by paying {5}{G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
As Sin enters, remove all counters from all artifacts, enchantments and creatures you control, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin.
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping Sin, untapping Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Sin.
Choose to return Sin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sin dies, it triggers, putting its counters on Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {U} equal to its power.
Repeat.

797-2743-6231.manaNeeded: {2}{U} plus enough mana to cast the copy spell
797-2743-6231.notablePrerequisites: You've cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
797-2743-6231.description:
Activate Thunderclap Drake by paying {2}{U} and sacrificing it.
Cast Stolen Identity by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Thunderclap Drake triggers, copying Stolen Identity at least twice, with all copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Stolen Identity spells, creating at least three copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers, causing you to win the game.

273-2907-6246.description:
Activate Shuko's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting a creature you control.
The creature triggers, causing you to reveal the top card of your library and put it onto the battlefield if it's a land card, or put it into your hand otherwise.
If a land was put onto the battlefield, each Scute Swarm you control triggers, creating either that many 1/1 Insect creature tokens or that many token copies of Scute Swarm.
Resolve the equip ability from step 1.
Repeat as able.

4094-4444-5742-5743.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
4094-4444-5742-5743.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Noose Constrictor by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Noose Constrictor ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

2452-3249-5670-6094--56.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2452-3249-5670-6094--56.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast a Zombie from your graveyard this turn.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Zombie.
When the Zombie dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

719-1219-1409-4221-4438.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five lands, plus additional lands that do not have summoning sickness and can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Beledros.
"Cleric" chosen with Xenograft.
719-1219-1409-4221-4438.description:
Activate Ancestor's Prophet by tapping five lands you control, causing you to gain 10 life.
Activate any number of other lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Beledros by paying 10 life, untapping all lands you control.
Activate Beledros by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Beledros enters the battlefield, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Beledros.
Repeat.
If the additional lands can tap to produce at least {2}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana.

293-1930-4871-5220.description:
Activate Undercity Informer by paying {1} and sacrificing Narcomoeba.
When Narcomoeba dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Narcomoeba on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Undercity Informer ability, causing you to put Narcomoeba into your graveyard from the top of your library.
Narcomoeba triggers, returning itself to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

944-2604-4489.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand that has Morph or Megamorph.
944-2604-4489.description:
Cast the creature using its morph or megamorph cost by paying {0}, putting it face-down on the battlefield as a 3/3 creature.
Activate Primordial Mist by exiling the face down creature face up, allowing you to cast it this turn.
Repeat.

2012-3581-4053.description:
Activate Kykar by sacrificing Strangleroot Geist, adding {R}.
Strangleroot Geist dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the batltefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

598-2438-4871.notablePrerequisites: Liliana has at least three loyalty counters.
598-2438-4871.description:
Activate Liliana by removing three loyalty counters from it, allowing you to cast Zombie cards from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Carrion Feeder either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
Carrion Feeder dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, not putting a +1/+1 counter on it due to it no longer being on the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat from step 2.

1741-4766-5105-5256.notablePrerequisites:
Deathrender attached to Cloud of Faeries.
You control lands that produce at least {1}{W}.
1741-4766-5105-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cloud of Faeries.
Sigil of the New Dawn and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve Sigil of the New Dawn's trigger, paying {1}{W} to return Cloud of Faeries from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Deathrender's trigger, putting Cloud of Faeries from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, triggering itself, untapping two lands you control that can produce {1}{W}.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill three cards.
Repeat.

253-2358-4591.description:
Activate Blood Celebrant by paying {B} and one life, adding {B}.
Repeat step 1 until you have zero life.
Activate Soul Conduit by paying {6} and tapping it, exchanging your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.
You may repeat this on each of your turns.
